description: Returns Space Monkey's MCP knowledge documents (analyst preamble, metric guardrails, live OpenAPI schema URL) as tool output for clients that cannot read MCP resources — read this before interpreting any Space Monkey metrics.

topic.description: Optional short topic selector to fetch a single knowledge document (one of: analyst-preamble, metric-guardrails, openapi, faq). Omit this parameter to receive every knowledge document.

name: sm_get_knowledge

outputSchema.description: Knowledge document(s) with version and lastUpdated metadata. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

description.description: Human-readable description of the enclosing item.

topic.description: Topic key the document belongs to.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

text.description: Full rendered text of the enclosing document or prompt.

title.description: Human-readable title for the enclosing item.

topic.description: Topic key, or null when the request did not match a single topic.

uri.description: MCP resource URI for the knowledge document or topic.

version.description: Version string for the enclosing catalog or document.

title: Get analyst knowledge
